lines: Heaven made, hell made, the man between two bodies.
When that breaks, he fits himself to another by fitness.
sanskrit_cite: svargamayo nirayamayas tad ayaṃ dehāntarālagaḥ puruṣaḥ | tadbhaṅge svaucityād dehāntarayogam abhyeti

lines: As the self once shone for him in the hour of knowing,
so then, when flesh falls, it cannot else become.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jñānāvasare svātmā sakṛd asya yādṛg avabhātaḥ | tādṛśa eva tadāsau na dehapāte 'nyathā bhavati

lines: Senses robbed, memory lost, breath choked and cut,
pains in the vitals: enjoyment born of flesh.
sanskrit_cite: karaṇagaṇasaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtināśaḥ śvāsakalilatā cchedaḥ | marmasu rujāviśeṣāḥ śarīrasaṃskārajo bhogaḥ

lines: How could the embodied be otherwise? Yet,
though fooled, at dying hour the knower falls not from self truth.
sanskrit_cite: sa kathaṃ vigrahayoge sati na bhavet tena mohayoge 'pi | maraṇāvasare jñāni na cyavate svātmaparamārthāt

lines: This road of truth, soon gained from the teacher's lips,
by keenest falling grace, unblocked Siva.
sanskrit_cite: paramārthamārgam enaṃ jhaṭiti yadā gurumukhāt samabhyeti | atitīvraśaktipātāt tadaiva nirvighnam eva śivaḥ

lines: Past every form, climbing step by step to rest,
rooted in highest truth, at the end made Siva.
sanskrit_cite: sarvottīrṇaṃ rūpaṃ sopānapadakrameṇa saṃśrayataḥ | paratattvarūḍhilābhe paryante śivamayībhāvaḥ

lines: But his stream of truth, unreached, at rest midway,
though his heart yearns for that step, death may come first.
sanskrit_cite: tasya tu paramārthamayīṃ dhārām agatasya madhyaviśrānteḥ | tatpadalābhotsukacetaso 'pi maraṇaṃ kadācit syāt

lines: Fallen from yoga, the books still call him lord of bright worlds.
Rested by his stage, next birth he turns to Siva.
sanskrit_cite: yogabhraṣṭaḥ śāstre kathito 'sau citrabhogabhuvanapatiḥ | viśrāntisthānavaśād bhūtvā janmāntare śivībhavati

lines: Though he miss the mark yet walk the road of truth,
he shares the gods' delight, glad hearted, long.
sanskrit_cite: paramārthamārgam enaṃ hy abhyasyāprāpya yogam api nāma | suralokabhogabhāgī muditamanā modate suciram
